mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 103.0 and housing starts (HOUST) above 1170.0 over the past 3 months signals robust economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST exceed their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 235.0), a decline in the federal funds rate below 0.4% triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the central bank responds to inflation with rate cuts.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0 and FEDFUNDS falls below 0.4%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer demand and construction activity, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST is above 1170.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the number of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falls below 140,000 thousand in a 3-month window, it signals labor market contraction that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS is below 140000.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle economic regime (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.5% annually), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 450,000 million dollars triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending weakens.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS falls below 450,000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.4% and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over the past 3 months signals a central bank's aggressive response to economic weakness, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing in response to labor market weakness
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.4% and UNRATE is above 4.5%.
